description:
By default, the Local Cache file won't be removed when the user sign out. If a user accesses a system where it's desirable to have the Local Cache file deleted when they sign out, set Clear Cache On Logoff to Enabled.

Registry Entry:  HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\FSLogix\ODFC\ClearCacheOnLogoff
Type:  DWORD
Values:  0 = Disabled, 1 = Enabled
